best_idea: An accept names the exact version of the partner's offer that the accepter saw, so an offer that changed in flight can never be settled by an old click; every edit changes the version and clears both accepts, and the second accept re-checks everything before one commit.
decision_why: Adopt the offer version bound to the accept, which closes the race between one side's edit and the other's accept that the reset-only gates in the ModernUO and EQEmu notes leave open; keep the capacity-first all-or-nothing settle; reject the donor's stock clock as written (reset to now drops the partial interval) and fix it by advancing in whole intervals.
acceptance: Two test players: A offers a sword, B accepts A's version v1, A adds 10 gold (version v2, both accepts clear); B's earlier accept with v1 returns stale and does not settle; B re-accepts with v2, A accepts, one settle moves the sword and 10 gold and the wallet total is unchanged. A vendor with a 60 s refill and 1 unit per interval, opened every 59 s, gains 9 units by the 590 s read and 10 by a read at 600 s; the donor's clock gives 5 by 590 s (worked by hand from the code, to be confirmed by a test).
